question: Under the official August 2025 Excalibur erratum, Arthur attacks with textless Excalibur and an ability BOOST of 3; the defender plays Feint with defense value 2. Does the BOOST still apply, what are the final attack value and attack damage, and does this ruling also preserve the BOOST on Noble Sacrifice if Feint actually cancels that card’s effects?
expected_answer: Textless Excalibur keeps the ability BOOST because there are no printed effects for Feint to cancel; attack6+3=9 and attack damage9-2=7; Noble Sacrifice has an effect which Feint cancels, so Arthur ability BOOST does not survive on it.
required_facts: Textless Excalibur retains ability BOOST under official2025 change
Noble Sacrifice exception does not apply: its effects are canceled and ability BOOST is discarded without effect
source_refs: Original Arthur character and action sheet (Excalibur6, Noble Sacrifice effects)
